tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring contact lens solution on a plane?

travelTips: Contact lens solution is classified as a medically necessary liquid and is exempt from the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Declare it to officers for manual screening.

faq.question: Is contact lens solution allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Contact Lens Solution is allowed in carry-on luggage. Contact lens solution is classified as a medically necessary liquid and is exempt from the 3-1-1 liquids rule. Declare it to officers for manual screening.

faq.question: Can you pack contact lens solution in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Contact Lens Solution is allowed in checked bags. Contact lens solution is allowed in checked baggage in any size.
